name: Soil phosphate, P2O5-equivalent plant-available phosphorus
source: Reported as P2O5 equivalent, the standard agronomic convention for the 'P' figure in an N-P2O5-K2O fertiliser analysis. P2O5 formula mass 141.943 from IUPAC standard atomic weights (P 30.974 x2, O 15.999 x5). P fraction 61.948/141.943 = 43.6429%.
notes: P is rounded to the nearest microgram; O closes exactly. The P2O5 convention is a reporting unit, not a claim that phosphorus exists in soil as the oxide; it lets this file line up with standard fertiliser labelling and analysis.
